Given the common knowledge of rationality, the optimal bidding strategy converges to bidding your true value. This is because any bid below your value risks losing the auction to a slightly higher bid, resulting in a missed opportunity to profit. Any bid above your value risks overpaying. Since values are redrawn each round and there's only one round, a simple strategy of bidding my value is optimal.
